apps.name: Melodix
apps.description:
Melodix — Music, Your Way.

Melodix is a modern, free music streaming experience designed for people who simply love music. Discover new tracks, revisit your favourites, create playlists, and enjoy your music in a clean and beautifully crafted interface.

🎧 Discover Your Sound

Explore a growing collection of songs, artists, albums, and genres. Whether you're looking for something new or returning to an old favourite, Melodix makes discovering music effortless.

❤️ Your Music, Your Collection

Save the songs you love and build your personal music library. Create playlists around your mood, taste, or moment and keep everything you enjoy in one place.

🔎 Find It Fast

Search for songs, artists, albums, and more with a simple and intuitive search experience.

🎵 A Beautiful Listening Experience

Melodix focuses on what matters most — your music. Enjoy a clean interface, smooth navigation, and a distraction-free player designed to make listening feel effortless.

✨ Made for Music Lovers

No complicated setup. No unnecessary clutter. Just open Melodix, find something you love, and press play.

Melodix — Discover. Listen. Repeat.

apps.name: Mail Guard
apps.tagline: AI-powered Gmail cleanup and email organization, built around your privacy and control.
apps.description:
Mail Guard — Your AI-Powered Email Guardian
Your inbox shouldn't be buried under promotions, subscriptions, old OTPs, spam, and suspicious emails.
Mail Guard helps you understand and organize your Gmail inbox intelligently. It uses AI-assisted classification to identify different types of emails and recommends what may be worth cleaning — while keeping you in control of every action.
✨ Smart Email Organization
Mail Guard can help identify:
Important and personal emails
Promotional emails
Subscription emails
Old OTP emails
Unnecessary emails
Spam
Potentially suspicious or fraudulent emails
🤖 AI-Powered Recommendations
Mail Guard doesn't blindly delete emails.
AI analyzes emails and provides recommendations. You decide what happens next.
AI recommends. You decide.
🧹 Safer Cleanup
Review recommended emails, select what you want to clean, and move them to Gmail Trash.
Automatic cleanup is not enabled by default. Future automation features can be enabled according to your preferences and rules.
🔐 Privacy Comes First
Mail Guard is designed with a privacy-first approach.
You choose when to connect your Google account and what permissions to grant. Your Gmail account remains under your control, and sensitive credentials such as AI API keys are never stored inside the Android application.
🛡️ Stay More Organized
From everyday promotions to old OTPs and suspicious messages, Mail Guard helps bring clarity to a crowded inbox so important emails are easier to find.
🔗 Google Account
Mail Guard uses Google's authorization system to connect your Gmail account. You can disconnect your account whenever you choose.
Mail Guard is built to make email management smarter — without taking control away from you.
Your Inbox. Smarter. Cleaner. Under Your Control.
